verifications.title: Verification queue
verifications.lead: Check the profile and open every account before approving.
verifications.approved: Approved. The blogger got an email.
verifications.rejected: Rejected. The blogger got an email.
verifications.reasonHint: The blogger sees this. Say what to fix.

accounts.title: Account review
accounts.lead: Accounts bloggers added after their profile was approved. Open each one: it must be public and its content fine for brands.
accounts.approved: Account approved. The blogger got a notification.
accounts.rejected: Account rejected. The blogger will see your reason.
accounts.reasonHint: The blogger sees this text. For example: the account is private, or the content is not suitable for brands.

briefReview.title: Brief review
briefReview.lead: Every brief is checked before bloggers see it. Approve it or send it back with a reason.
briefReview.approved: Brief is live. The brand got a notification.
briefReview.rejected: Sent back. The brand will see your reason.
briefReview.reasonHint: The brand sees this text. Be specific: what is wrong and how to fix it.

users.title: Users
users.resetSentToast: Reset link sent. It works for 1 hour.
